parent_domains.justification: Prenatal care is a component of health care, specifically focusing on the health of pregnant individuals and the care leading up to childbirth.
Prenatal care is a form of patient-centered care focused on pregnant women.

closest_parent_domain.justification: All aspects of prenatal care, including medical and supportive services, fall under the broader category of health care.

closest_child_domain.justification: There are no child domains explicitly listed under prenatal care in the given list.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: Neonatology deals with the care of newborns, closely aligning with prenatal care which focuses on outcomes just before birth.
